description: List the account's media library (own recordings and referenced YouTube/TikTok/Instagram Reels/web videos) with status, tags, summary and reuse_policy. Respect reuse_policy: "reusable" footage (own/licensed) may be cut into new work; "reference_only" third-party media is for analysis, structure and style reference only, never copied into an output.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries or matches to return.

origin.description: Filter to a source platform or the user’s own recording.

query.description: Search text for matching media library entries or moments.

reuse_policy.description: Filter by the library’s recorded footage reuse policy.

tag.description: Filter entries by their saved tag.

name: media_library_list
title: List media library
